text: Accept valid catalogue lines with quantities 1–5 and return one durable order identity per request key.
criteria: Replay a valid order request; reject an unknown SKU, quantity 0 or conflicting key reuse; one valid order persists.

text: Process accepted work asynchronously; transition to DISPATCHED only after the simulator confirms a stable dispatch reference.
criteria: Simulator commits then times out; retry with the same dispatch key yields one dispatch reference and eventual DISPATCHED state.

text: Cancellation succeeds only while ACCEPTED; a race with preparation commits exactly one permitted transition.
criteria: Race cancellation and preparation; verify one accepted transition and no dispatch of a successfully cancelled order.

text: The buyer can read only their orders; a return is accepted for review only within seven days of dispatch, inclusive at the exact cutoff.
criteria: Test return at the seven-day cutoff and one second after; accept only the former. A different buyer cannot inspect or return it.

text: Publish stable-ID status events and retain failed dispatch work for authorized retry without a second dispatch effect.
criteria: Simulator commits then times out; retry with the same dispatch key yields one dispatch reference and eventual DISPATCHED state.
Redeliver the status event and dispatch message; consumer effects and dispatch reference remain unique.

text: Under nominal simulator responses, 100 accepted orders reach DISPATCHED within two minutes; report queue drain and end-to-end latency.
criteria: Process the 100-order workload with nominal simulator behavior and retain completion/backlog evidence.
